meta.note: HSK (2.0) ↔ TOCFL ↔ CEFR alignment, kept as data so the mapping lives in one place rather than scattered through the code. Used by build_skeleton.py to tag units and by the progress dashboard.
meta.caveat: TOCFL's own vocabulary targets run ahead of HSK 2.0 at every band — TOCFL Level 3 expects ~2,500 words against HSK 4's 1,200 cumulative. Completing HSK 4 here therefore covers TOCFL Level 3's themes and grammar but roughly half its vocabulary. UI copy must say 'aligned to', never 'covers'.
